retained_evidence.excerpt_or_note: The opened page identifies this school in Geilston Bay, Hobart, Tasmania and gives coordinates -42.8376, 147.3488. Its infobox says closed 9 December 2013, while the History text says 19 December 2013; preserve the date conflict.
The department annual report describes the planned Archives Repository as being at the former Geilston Bay High School site, indicating reuse of the site rather than an educational successor.
retained_evidence.source_title: Tasmanian Department of Education Annual Report 2015–16

retained_evidence.excerpt_or_note: The school is identified at the exact named Geilston Bay site and an official Tasmanian parliamentary transcript confirms it closed in 2013. The date is conflicting in the opened secondary source (9 vs 19 December), while the official transcript does not give a day. Tasmanian Department of Education material documents later Archives use of the former school site; this is site reuse, not evidence of an educational successor. No current ACARA target is suitable. Propose a closed manual historical institution for human review; all closure, location, and site-history conclusions remain pending human review.
